purpose: Calibration evidence for residual_source (ADR 0011 section 6): window medians of the face check, read against the user's blind verdicts of 9 October 2026 on the Tears of Steel recast trial and Batch 1.
observation: Every window the user judged as replaced is at most 0.323 (058 D 0.323/0.229, 058 C 0.219/0.297, all 056 renders at most 0.06). Every non-negative window the user judged as a leak or hybrid is at least 0.341 (058 B window 2 0.341, 061 w1 hybrids 0.345/0.349); photographic-negative copies read 0.36-0.39 and are failed by inverted_copy instead. The 6 October evidence (pass at most 0.25, fail at least 0.43) still holds. One film: the tighter fail bound should be re-checked on the next film.
